description: Up to five places from Google Places whose names match q: countries, states and provinces, counties, cities and ZIP or postal codes, never an address or a business. Each has an id and its text; read the one you want with get_place, and put the result in the wording's place. (GET /api/v1/places)

q.description: What to look for, such as Alaska or Bethel.

session.description: Optional: one UUID you make for a search and the read that follows it, which Google bills as one session.

name: search_places
title: Search places
